message.content: Based on the information provided, Li Hua did not initially inform Wolfgang about making a new friend before Yuriko reminded the group members to meet for the music festival. In the initial conversation, Li Hua only mentions that he has a friend named Chae, who is a neurosurgeon, but he does not mention Yuriko at this point. Instead, it was Yuriko who brought up the topic of bringing a friend to the jam session, and Li Hua responded by informing Wolfgang and Wolfgang's friend WolfgangSchulz that his friend's name is Chae. Thus, Wolfgang was not aware of Li Hua having a new friend before Yuriko introduced this detail to the group.
